summary: @c1-ease/autoloan ships beacon.cjs that collects host/environment info
details: The package includes beacon.cjs which requires both http and https modules and reads host/environment identifiers including process.cwd() and process.version together with os module data. This file matches the simple sysinfo exfiltration shape: collection of installer-side host identifiers alongside an outbound HTTP client in the same small module. The package name resembles a private/internal-scope namespace (@c1-ease) with a lending-related name, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package of the same name. Combined with the sysinfo-beacon file shape, installing or loading this package risks sending host-identifying data from the installer environment to an external destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
